s: a granite-cliff fishing village on Sweden's west coast, framed by a dramatic rock backdrop
w: Colourful wooden fishing-village houses sit at the foot of a sheer granite ridge (Vetteberget) on the Bohuslän coast, with a scatter of skerries and islands just offshore. Small enough to walk in an hour, it's long drawn Scandinavian summer visitors and crime novelist Camilla Läckberg, whose books are set here -- but the light on the granite at either end of the day is the real reason to come.
_facts: Fishing village in Tanum Municipality on Sweden's Bohuslän coast
Backed by the granite ridge Vetteberget, with a network of surrounding skerries and islands
Setting for Camilla Läckberg's Fjällbacka crime novels
Historic summer resort for the Swedish royal family and Ingrid Bergman, among others
